page.overview:
Who is Barbarian Smithers?

Barbarian Smithers is Waylon Smithers' character in Earthland Realms.

He was seen in the window in the town. When the Shadow Knight arrived there, Barbarian Smithers quickly closed the shutters to hide inside of the house.

He was also one of the characters who killed the Shadow Knight when he was weak. Warrior Marge later possibly killed him as a revenge.
